  • Oversee the end-to-end complaints control framework, including complaint identification and classification, regulatory and internal service-level requirements, escalation thresholds, documentation standards, investigation and resolution expectations, and closed-loop validation.
  • Own the second-line oversight and quality assurance, including risk-based testing of complaint handling, identification of control gaps and customer-outcome issues, tracking of remediation, and escalation of issues.
  • Turn complaint data into actionable compliance and conduct-risk intelligence by monitoring trends, recurring issues, root causes, regulatory complaints, overdue cases, customer outcomes, and potential systemic issues requiring broader investigation or remediation.
  • Own complaints governance and executive reporting, including reporting to compliance committees and serving as the standing owner of the complaints agenda for compliance leadership meetings.
  • Maintain the complaint management database, service level agreement adherence, and escalation thresholds across all regions.
  • Serve as the central Compliance point of contact for material complaint matters, including complaints or inquiries escalated to regulators, ensuring consistent governance, appropriate escalation, and defensible documentation.
  • Drive continuous improvement of the framework, using QA results, regulatory developments, complaint trends, and lessons learned to strengthen controls and improve customer outcomes globally.
 
What We Look For In You
  • Strong experience developing and managing responses to regulators is required, including regulatory inquiries, information requests, examinations, escalated customer complaints, and other supervisory matters. Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional inputs, develop clear and defensible written responses, manage regulatory deadlines, and track resulting commitments and remediation through closure.
  • Significant experience in regulatory compliance, conduct risk, consumer protection, complaints oversight, or a related discipline, ideally within a highly regulated and globally distributed organization.
  • Demonstrated experience owning or overseeing a multi-jurisdictional compliance framework, including translating regulatory requirements into scalable global standards, controls, monitoring, and governance while appropriately incorporating local requirements.
  • Strong regulatory and customer-outcome judgment, with the ability to distinguish individual service issues from matters presenting potential regulatory, conduct, consumer-harm, reputational, or systemic risk.
  • Demonstrated experience with root-cause analysis and systemic remediation, including assessing whether broader customer populations may be affected and driving appropriate corrective action.
  • Strong second-line oversight and challenge capabilities, with experience designing or operating risk-based monitoring, QA, issue escalation, remediation tracking, and governance processes.
  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities, trend analysis, SLA monitoring, management information, and executive reporting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with regulators, Legal, Compliance, senior executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to influence geographically dispersed teams and senior stakeholders.
 
Nice-To-Haves
  • Experience designing or overseeing a global customer complaints program across multiple regulatory regimes, particularly the United States, United Kingdom, European Union, APAC, LATAM, and/or Middle East.
  • Familiarity with complaints-handling and customer protection expectations across major global regulatory regimes, including those established by the FCA, CFPB, MAS, European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, ESMA and EIOPA), and other relevant national competent authorities and dispute-resolution bodies.
  • Relevant professional certification or advanced qualification such as CAMS, CFE, CRCM, CCEP/CCEP-I, ICA compliance qualifications, CIA, CRCMP, JD or equivalent legal qualification, or a comparable compliance, risk, or audit credential.

description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are building a scalable financial operations platform to support the accurate movement, recording, reconciliation and reporting of fiat and digital assets. The Head of Financial Operations Platform will define and deliver the architecture that connects our trading, payment, banking, custody, blockchain, wallet and finance systems.
This is a senior, hands-on platform leadership role. The successful candidate will establish trusted books and records, automate settlement and reconciliation, create effective exception workflows and give Operations and Finance the tools required to maintain accurate client and corporate asset records on a daily and, where feasible, near-real-time basis.
The role owns platform capability and delivery. Client Asset Operations and Finance retain responsibility for executing, reviewing and signing off the underlying operational and accounting controls.
 

What You Will Own

  • Product strategy and multi-year roadmap for the financial operations platform.
  • The canonical transaction and financial-event model across fiat and digital assets.
  • Client and corporate asset subledgers, balances, positions, journals and transaction histories.
  • Settlement and asset-movement workflows across banks, payment providers, custodians, wallets, blockchains and trading venues.
  • Multi-way transaction- and balance-level reconciliation across operational sources, internal records and the finance system.
  • Exception management, operational dashboards, control evidence, audit trails and management reporting.
  • Build-versus-buy assessments, strategic vendors, migration, backfilling, parallel runs and legacy-process retirement.

First Year Outcomes

  • Document the end-to-end transaction, asset and accounting architecture.
  • Establish an approved platform roadmap and target operating model.
  • Define the canonical financial-event, subledger and reconciliation data model.
  • Deliver systematic reconciliation for the highest-risk fiat and digital asset flows.
  • Introduce centralized exception ownership, ageing, escalation and evidence.
  • Reduce spreadsheet dependency and engineering-dependent investigations.
  • Improve alignment between operational records, customer liabilities, external asset records and the finance system.
  • Deliver a credible path from daily controls to near-real-time monitoring for material flows.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Product Strategy and Architecture
    - Establish the target vision, operating principles and roadmap for ledger, settlement, reconciliation and client asset controls.
    - Map end-to-end funds and asset flows across deposits, withdrawals, trades, fees, transfers, financing, staking and other relevant products.
    - Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define scalable services, APIs, event schemas, data contracts, system boundaries and resilience requirements.
    - Make evidence-based build-versus-buy decisions and prevent fragmented point solutions from becoming the operating model.

 

  • Ledger and Books and Records
    - Define requirements for double-entry ledgering, journals, balances, positions and transaction traceability.
    - Establish clear lineage from the originating operational event through the subledger and financial reporting environment.
    - Ensure the platform handles reversals, corrections, fees, foreign exchange, internal transfers, failed transactions, duplicated events and delayed events.
    - Work with Finance to maintain controlled alignment between operational books and records and the ERP or general ledger.

 

  • Settlement and Reconciliation
    - Design workflows for fiat and digital asset settlement, including cut-offs, confirmations, status management, retries and failure handling.
    - Build automated multi-way reconciliation across trading engines, payment systems, banks, custodians, wallets, blockchain records, subledgers and ERP systems.
    - Define configurable matching rules, tolerances, materiality levels, frequencies and escalation thresholds.
    - Create near-real-time detection for missing, duplicated, delayed or incorrectly recorded transactions where feasible and proportionate.

 

  • Operational Tooling and Controls
    - Build operator interfaces that support investigation and resolution without routine dependence on engineering queries or spreadsheets.
    - Incorporate maker-checker approvals, role-based access, segregation of duties, evidence retention and complete audit histories.
    - Define monitoring and alerting for data completeness, balance integrity, settlement failures, reconciliation breaks and control execution.
    - Support audit, regulatory examination and financial-reporting requirements with reproducible system evidence.

 

  • Delivery and Stakeholder Leadership
    - Lead discovery, requirements definition, prioritization, testing, rollout and post-launch improvement.
    - Write clear product requirements, workflow diagrams, data definitions, control requirements and acceptance criteria.
    - Coordinate operational readiness across Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Treasury, Custody, Risk and Compliance.
    - Lead data migration, backfilling and parallel-run validation before replacing existing controls or processes.
    - Communicate roadmap priorities, risks, dependencies and measurable outcomes to senior management.
 

What We Look For In You

  • Eight or more years in fintech, financial services, digital assets, brokerage, custody, payments or capital-markets technology.
  • Five or more years of product-management, platform leadership, technical program leadership or comparable engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated delivery of a ledger, reconciliation platform, settlement system, payments infrastructure, brokerage books-and-records platform or digital asset back office.
  • Strong understanding of transaction lifecycles, balances, positions, journal entries, reconciliation and financial controls.
  • Technical fluency with APIs, event-driven systems, data schemas, batch and streaming pipelines, integrations, idempotency and failure handling.
  • Ability to work directly with transaction-level data; practical SQL proficiency is strongly preferred.
  • Track record of delivering mission-critical systems in regulated or control-intensive environments.
  • Strong written communication, structured problem-solving and senior stakeholder-management skills.
 

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with both fiat and digital asset transaction flows.
  • Knowledge of blockchain transactions, wallets, custodians and on-chain settlement.
  • Experience integrating with ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, NetSuite or Microsoft Dynamics.
  • Familiarity with client asset segregation, safeguarding, books and records or comparable regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with high-volume, continuously operating financial platforms.
  • Knowledge of double-entry accounting and financial-close processes.
  • Experience replacing manual reconciliation with automated platform capabilities.
  • Experience assessing or implementing platforms such as Crypto or comparable ledger, reconciliation and digital asset accounting solutions.
 

Perks & Benefits

  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants 
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a product-driven marketing leader to accelerate the growth and adoption of OKX products across North East Asia.
This is not a traditional brand or events-focused marketing role. The role sits at the intersection of Product, Growth, Marketing and Business, with a strong focus on understanding CeFi products, identifying market opportunities, and translating them into measurable user and business growth.
The ideal candidate has strong product sense, understands crypto users and trading behavior, and is highly data-driven. You should be comfortable working closely with Product, BD, VIP, Affiliate and local market teams to identify growth opportunities, build GTM strategies, and continuously improve acquisition, activation, engagement, retention and monetization.
You will also need strong judgment when operating across different market and regulatory environments, ensuring that growth strategies, user targeting and marketing execution are appropriate for each market.
 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own the product growth marketing strategy for NEA, with a strong focus on measurable business outcomes, including user acquisition, activation, trading activity, retention and revenue.
  • Develop a deep understanding of CeFi products and crypto trading, including Spot, Derivatives, Earn, Copy Trading, Trading Bots, VIP products and other key trading tools, and identify which products and features can become meaningful growth drivers in each market.
  • Build and execute product-led GTM strategies based on local user behavior, competitor dynamics and market opportunities rather than relying primarily on brand campaigns or offline events.
  • Work closely with Product, Business, BD, VIP, Affiliate and regional teams to translate product capabilities into user acquisition, conversion and monetization opportunities.
  • Use data to understand the full user funnel, identify growth bottlenecks and continuously optimize campaigns, product positioning, incentives, conversion journeys and user segmentation.
  • Understand and effectively use different digital and growth marketing tools, including performance marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, referral, affiliate, KOL/influencer channels, promotions and incentive mechanisms.
  • Develop clear user segmentation strategies across retail traders, active traders, high-value users and other relevant customer groups, and design differentiated product propositions and growth strategies for each segment.
  • Act as the voice of NEA users to global Product teams by identifying product gaps, competitive disadvantages and emerging user needs, and help prioritize opportunities that can materially improve growth.
  • Conduct structured analysis of competitors, including their products, pricing, incentives, campaigns, user journeys and growth mechanisms, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Establish clear KPIs and measurement frameworks for major marketing initiatives, with strong accountability for their impact on product adoption and business growth.
  • Develop market-specific GTM strategies with appropriate consideration for local regulatory requirements, user targeting, communication boundaries and distribution approaches, working closely with relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Build scalable growth playbooks that can be tested in individual NEA markets and expanded when proven successful.

What We Look For In You

  • Strong CeFi and crypto product knowledge is essential. You should understand how centralized exchanges work and be familiar with major trading products, user journeys and the competitive landscape.
  • Strong product sense — able to understand why users choose one product over another, identify product-market gaps, and translate product capabilities into compelling growth propositions.
  • Highly data-driven and commercially minded. Comfortable using data to diagnose problems, prioritize opportunities and measure whether marketing initiatives actually contribute to user and revenue growth.
  • Strong understanding of digital growth tools and mechanics, including performance marketing, CRM/lifecycle marketing, referral, affiliate, KOL channels, promotions, incentives and conversion optimization.
  • Proven experience driving measurable business or product growth, rather than primarily managing branding, communications, events or community activities.
  • Strong understanding of crypto user behavior, particularly active traders and high-value users. Direct crypto trading experience is highly desirable.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Product and Business teams and influence priorities without relying on direct reporting lines.
  • Strong market judgment and awareness of how growth strategies may need to differ across regulatory and market environments.
  • Ability to balance growth ambition with responsible execution, including appropriate user segmentation, targeting, communication and channel strategies.
  • Strong analytical capability in market research, competitive analysis, funnel analysis and campaign performance.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to turn complex product and market insights into clear priorities and executable plans.

You will be the single accountable owner who turns a campaign concept into a shipped, measured, and reflected-upon outcome by orchestrating creative, media, lifecycle, BD, KOL ops, product marketing, and legal. The number on the campaign is yours. You drive the outcome.

What you will own
  1. Affiliate campaigns: Activation pulses on top of the always-on affiliate channel. Coordinated with BD and BD Operations.
  2. Listing campaigns: New token listing campaigns shipped within 24 hours of listing decisions. Tight loop with Listing PM, legal, comms, BD/KOL Ops, exchange ops.
  3. Trade & Earn campaigns: Volume incentives, leaderboards, zero fee promos. Built around clear unit economics and incrementality, not vanity volume.
  4. Launch campaigns: Product and feature launches. Coordinated with product marketing, product team, social team, and lifecycle team.

What you will do

  1. Translate fuzzy stakeholder asks into clear campaign briefs that creative, paid, and lifecycle can act on without a six-revision loop.
  2. Build and own campaign plans with clear gates, dependencies, owners, and dates. Hold stakeholders accountable when slots slip.
  3. Define success metrics with analytics before launch, not after. Run holdouts where possible. Run reflection sessions within 7 days of campaign close. Publish learnings the team can reuse.
  4. Navigate MiCA and MiFID II constraints with legal. You will not be the lawyer, but you will know enough to flag the risks early and propose alternatives.
  5. Be the connective tissue between EEA Growth and Global Campaigns. Localise global playbooks to EEA markets. Push EEA-originated wins back to global for global execution.

Must-haves:
  • Four to seven years total experience, two-plus years coordinating end-to-end campaigns at a tier 1 regulated crypto exchange (Binance, Kraken, Bitpanda, Coinbase, or similar). You have shipped at least 10 campaigns with named numbers attached. And you have the receipts.

  • Analytical literacy: you can read a campaign dashboard, spot the wrong attribution, ask the right question of analytics, and present results to leadership.
  • Budget discipline. You understand CAC payback, ROAS, incremental volume, LTV.

Who you are

  • Competitive. You want your campaign on the leaderboard against Global. You want EEA to outperform.
  • Crypto-native. You trade. You have a wallet. You know which tokens listed last week and which exchange ran the best campaign around it. You have opinions.
  • Detail-oriented. You catch the wrong token contract address in a launch comms draft before legal does.
  • Fast. The good campaigns ship within hours of the news, not days.

title: Head of Compliance: Multilateral Trading Facility (MTF)
description:
Reports to: Regional Head of Compliance, EMEA (with matrix reporting to the OEM Board and Global Compliance) 

Regulator: Malta Financial Services Authority (MFSA) 

About the Team

The compliance function at OKX is responsible for the overall compliance culture at the company. We are a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on the company's AML and regulatory obligations and enterprise risks.

OKX Europe Markets Limited is our MFSA-authorised investment services entity. Its licence covers the operation of a multilateral trading facility alongside our MiFID derivatives business. Operating a trading venue puts a distinct set of obligations on the firm: venue rulebook governance, member admission, market surveillance, transparency and reporting, systems resilience and orderly trading controls. This role owns compliance for that venue.

What You Will Be Doing

As Head of Compliance for the MTF, you will hold the MiFID compliance function for the trading venue and act as the MFSA-approved person for that role. The MLRO function sits separately; you will work alongside the OEM MLRO on financial crime matters that touch venue activity.

You will:

  • Own the MTF compliance framework end to end: policies, procedures, controls, registers and the compliance monitoring programme covering MiFID II, MiFIR, MAR and the MFSA Investment Services Rules applicable to MTF operators.
  • Act as the primary compliance point of contact for the MFSA on venue matters: authorisation variations, notifications, thematic reviews, RFIs, inspections and remediation.
  • Own the venue rulebook. Keep it current, ensure it is enforceable, and run the governance process for changes.
  • Oversee member and participant admission: eligibility criteria, non-discriminatory access, direct electronic access arrangements, sponsored access controls, and ongoing monitoring of members' compliance with the rules of the venue.
  • Oversee admission to trading of financial instruments, including the compliance assessment of new instruments, product classes and tokenised or DLT-based instruments where relevant.
  • Provide compliance oversight of orderly trading requirements: systems capacity and resilience, testing of members' algorithms, circuit breakers, order-to-trade ratios, tick sizes, market making schemes and clock synchronisation.
  • Provide compliance oversight of pre- and post-trade transparency, waivers and deferrals, transaction reporting, reference data and the accuracy and completeness controls behind them.
  • Advise the business on the interaction between the MTF and OKX's wider European footprint: the MiFID derivatives business, MiCA-authorised activity in OKX Europe Ltd, and the DLT Pilot Regime where a DLT MTF is in scope.
  • Deliver the annual compliance risk assessment, the compliance monitoring plan and the compliance report to senior management and the Board.
  • Build, lead and develop the MTF compliance team, and set the compliance training curriculum for venue-facing staff, trading operations and technology.
  • Give day-to-day advice to product, engineering, trading operations, legal and market operations in a fast-moving regulatory environment, including sign-off on venue changes, launches and marketing where required.
  • Oversee compliance aspects of outsourcing, critical third parties and operational resilience, including DORA obligations relevant to the venue.
  • Prepare Board, committee and matrix stakeholder reporting, and represent OKX with the MFSA, ESMA consultations, industry bodies and peer venue forums.

What We Look For in You

  • 10 years plus in regulatory compliance within financial services, market infrastructure, fintech or crypto, including time at a senior or head-of-function level.
  • Direct experience of trading venue compliance: MTF, OTF, regulated market, SI or an equivalent execution venue. This is the core requirement.
  • Working knowledge of MiFID II and MiFIR as they apply to venue operators: Articles 18–20 and 31 (MTF operating requirements and rule monitoring), Articles 48–50 (orderly trading), MiFIR transparency and transaction reporting, and the associated RTS.
  • Practical experience of market abuse surveillance and MAR obligations for a venue operator, including STOR decision-making.
  • Experience developing and owning a compliance framework that has stood up to regulatory examination, and a track record of engaging supervisors directly.
  • Experience preparing and defending compliance reporting to a board or regulator.
  • Familiarity with MFSA Investment Services Rules and Malta's regulatory environment, or a demonstrable ability to get there quickly from another EEA jurisdiction.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to run several regulatory workstreams to deadline.
  • Comfortable working independently and in a dispersed, cross-border team across multiple varied tasks.
  • Highly ethical, intuitive, and willing to question and challenge at every level of the business.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain venue regulation to engineers and commercial teams.
  • Eligible for MFSA approval as the holder of the compliance function.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Haves

  • Prior experience in the crypto industry, particularly tokenised instruments, crypto derivatives or a MiCA-authorised trading platform.
  • Experience with the DLT Pilot Regime or another distributed ledger market infrastructure.
  • Experience of a trading venue authorisation or a licence variation to add MTF operation.

title: Independent Non-Executive Director (Resident), Seychelles
description:
Independent Non-Executive Director (Resident), Seychelles
 
About OKX
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
Our Seychelles business has operated since 2017 and now sits within the licensing regime established by the Virtual Asset Service Providers Act of Seychelles 2024 (the VASP Act). We are seeking an Independent Non-Executive Director, resident in Seychelles, to join the board of our Seychelles entity to supplement its board of governance with an independent resident non-executive director.

About the Role
As an Independent Non-Executive Director and Resident Director of our Seychelles entity, you will bring independent challenge to strategy, risk and conduct, hold management to account on behalf of shareholders and stakeholders, and provide the resident board presence that the licence and the entity's governance arrangements require. The role exists to do three things at once: provide independent challenge; satisfy the Seychelles Financial Services Authority (the FSA) that the board of the Company meets its expectations on composition, competence and fitness and propriety under the VASP Act; and provide local substance in Seychelles.
The entity operates within the group's global governance, risk and compliance framework while remaining separately accountable to its own board and to its regulator. The Board comprises a mix of executive and independent non-executive directors. This is a genuinely resident role. The appointee must be physically present in Seychelles, attend board and management meetings in person, and be available to engage with the FSA and the entity's advisers in Seychelles.
A non-executive director carries the same general legal responsibilities to the entity as any other director, and must perform those duties faithfully, efficiently and diligently to a standard commensurate with the role and with their own knowledge, skills and experience.

What You’ll Be Doing
Independentally Challenge
  • Bring an external and independent perspective to strategy, risk and conduct, and hold management to account on behalf of shareholders and stakeholders.
  • Provide constructive challenge and strategic guidance, and offer specialist advice to the Board.
  • Scrutinise the performance of management and of individual executive directors against agreed goals, and monitor how that performance is reported.
  • Act in good faith, honestly and responsibly, and make decisions objectively in what you consider to be the interests of the entity.
Regulatory Standing & Local Substance
  • Satisfy the FSA that the board of the Company meets its expectations on composition, competence and fitness and propriety under the VASP Act.
  • Provide the physical, resident board presence in Seychelles that the licence and the entity's governance arrangements require.
  • Attend board and management meetings in person, and engage with the FSA and the entity's advisers in Seychelles as required.
Collective Board Responsibilities
  • Promote the long term sustainable success of the entity, generating value for shareholders and contributing to wider society.
  • Establish the entity's purpose, values and strategy, and satisfy the Board that its culture is aligned to them.
  • Provide effective, prudent and ethical oversight, act with integrity, lead by example and promote the desired culture.
  • Ensure the resources needed to meet the entity's objectives are in place, and measure performance against them.
  • Establish and lead within a framework of prudent and effective controls that allows risk to be assessed and managed.
  • Ensure effective engagement with shareholders and stakeholders.
  • Ensure workforce policies and practices are consistent with the entity's values.
Individual Director Responsibilities
  • Satisfy yourself on the integrity of the entity's financial information, its financial controls, and whether its risk management systems are robust and defensible.
  • Determine appropriate remuneration for executive directors, and play a leading part in appointing and, where necessary, removing them.
  • Contribute to the entity's succession planning.
  • Uphold the highest standards of integrity, and support the chairperson in setting the values, behaviours and culture of the boardroom and beyond.
Committee Service
Serve on one or more board committees where required. The relevant terms of reference will be provided on appointment.

What We Look for in You
  • Resident in Seychelles, and currently holding the right to reside and work there.
  • Able to satisfy the FSA's fitness and propriety assessment.
  • Board level or senior governance experience in a regulated financial services, banking, insurance, fiduciary or corporate services business.
  • Working knowledge of anti-money laundering and counter terrorist financing obligations, and of the Seychelles regulatory environment.
  • Financial literacy sufficient to interrogate financial statements, controls and risk reporting without support.
  • Demonstrable independence of mind, and the willingness to challenge management and record dissent.
  • Fluent in English, with excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
What Will Make You Stand Out
  • Experience of virtual assets, fintech, payments or capital markets.
  • Prior regulatory experience.
  • Experience chairing an audit, risk or compliance committee.
  • Experience of a group structure where much of the operating activity sits outside the licensed entity's jurisdiction, and of the oversight challenge that creates.
  • An established local network among Seychelles regulators, professional advisers and the financial services community.
 
Why Join OKX?
  • Play a pivotal role in the governance of a successful virtual asset business.
  • Bring independent oversight to a global crypto platform operating at scale across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Work alongside an experienced board and a global leadership team in a high-growth industry.
  • A defined, time-bounded commitment with genuine influence over strategy, risk and conduct.
 
Ready to Reshape Finance?
At OKX, we’re on a mission to make crypto accessible, secure, and transformative for the next billion users. Join us and help set the governance standard for virtual assets globally.

title: Institutional Relationship Management
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
 
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

What You’ll Be Doing

 
Institutional Client Development & Acquisition
  • Proactively identify and develop high-value institutional clients with significant asset scale and trading potential, including professional investment firms, asset management companies, quantitative trading teams, and family offices.
  • Build a consistent client pipeline through industry events, peer referrals, and in-person visits, and drive partnerships to closure efficiently.
Deep Relationship Management & Client Lifecycle
  • Develop a thorough understanding of each client's trading strategy, capital structure, and product needs, and deliver tailored service solutions accordingly.
  • Maintain regular and in-depth engagement with clients, foster long-term trust-based relationships, and continuously drive growth in assets under management, trading activity, and platform stickiness.
KPI Ownership & Business Performance
  • Take full ownership of key performance metrics for your client portfolio, including AUM, trading volume, and revenue contribution.
  • Consistently meet monthly and quarterly targets for asset onboarding and business activation, and optimize client value output over time.
Consultative Product Sales
  • Develop deep expertise across the platform's full product suite — including spot, derivatives, structured products, and institution-exclusive services — and provide tailored product recommendations based on each client's investment strategy and business objectives, helping clients optimize returns or achieve risk management goals.
Client Needs Synthesis & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Gather and synthesize institutional client pain points and customization requests. Coordinate with internal teams across product, risk, compliance, and operations to deliver bespoke solutions for key clients.
  • Proactively provide clients with market insights and professional guidance at critical moments.
Market Intelligence & Competitive Tracking
  • Stay current on institutional crypto market trends and competitor service strategies.
  • Regularly share market intelligence and client feedback internally to inform product development and business strategy.
高净值机构客户开发与拓展
  • 主动挖掘并开发具备高资产规模与高交易潜力的优质机构客户，目标群体涵盖专业投资机构、资产管理公司、量化团队等。通过行业活动、同业转介、线下拜访等多元渠道持续建立客户漏斗，快速识别高潜力目标并推动合作落地。
深度客户关系维护与生命周期管理
  • 深度理解所负责客户的交易策略、资金结构与产品需求，制定个性化服务方案。定期与客户保持深度沟通与回顾，维护稳固的长期合作关系，持续提升客户资产规模、交易活跃度与平台黏性。
核心业绩指标达成
  • 直接对所负责客户的资产规模、交易量及收益贡献等核心业绩指标负责，按月度/季度目标完成资产引入与业务激活，持续优化客户价值产出。
机构产品方案顾问式销售
  • 深入掌握平台现货、衍生品、结构化产品及机构专属服务等全产品线，能够根据不同机构客户的投资策略与业务需求，提供专业的产品组合建议，协助客户实现收益优化或风险管理目标。
客户需求收集与内部协同
  • 深度收集并整合机构客户的痛点与定制化需求，协调产品、风控、合规、运营等内部团队资源，推动重点客户方案落地。在关键市场节点主动为客户提供信息支持与专业建议。
行业洞察与竞品追踪
  • 持续跟踪机构加密市场动态及主要竞品的服务策略，定期向内部输出市场情报与客户反馈，为产品迭代和业务策略优化提供一线视角。
 

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in the Web3 industry, with hands-on usage or service experience related to major exchanges, wallets, custody solutions, DeFi products, etc.
  • Able to quickly identify and qualify target clients, with strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills. Experience in managing high-potential client relationships, client service or account operations is preferred. Basic understanding of financial markets, derivatives and risk–return; background in banking, securities or asset management is a strong plus.
  • Clear KPI & result orientation, and comfortable using data to measure and manage performance.
  • Comfortable with a high-intensity work pace and frequent travel / client visits.
  • Strong self-motivation and resilience, able to find paths forward and drive execution in an uncertain environment.
  • Able to work in both Chinese and English (listening, speaking, reading and writing).
  • Bachelor’s degree or above; majors in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or related fields are preferred.
  • \web3 行业工作经验，对主流交易所、钱包、托管、DeFi 等产品有实际使用或服务经验
  • 能够快速识别与筛选目标客户，具备优秀的沟通谈判技巧与关系维护能力，有高潜力客户的客户关系管对金融市场、衍生品、风险收益等有基本认知，有银行、券商、资管等金融背景者优先。客户服务和运营等相关工作经验优先；
  • 明确的KPI & 结果导向，习惯用数据衡量业绩。能接受高强度工作节奏与频繁出差 / 拜访。
  • 能适应高强度工作环境，可接受频繁出差及客户拜访。
  • 自驱力强，抗压能力好，能够在不确定环境中找到路径并推动落地。
  • 能够中英文双语工作（听说读写）；
  • 本科及以上学历，金融、经济、会计、数学、统计、计算机等相关专业优先。
 

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

title: Institutional Sales Manager
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand for hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of blockchain to users around the world through leading products including OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink, and more.
 

About the Role

As part of the Institutional Relationship Management team, you will serve as the primary point of contact for our institutional partners. Your mission is to cultivate long-term relationships, drive revenue growth through proactive sales and strategic engagement, and ensure a seamless operational experience for institutional clients.
This role sits at the intersection of institutional sales, client relationship management, and product collaboration, acting as a bridge between client needs and internal product capabilities. Performance will be evaluated through a balanced KPI framework focused on growth, new business development, and client service excellence to support sustainable revenue generation and operational quality.
 

What You’ll Be Doing

Business Development & Growth

  • Identify and qualify new institutional leads, managing the full sales cycle from initial outreach through to closing and post-sales client success.
  • Coordinate the end-to-end onboarding process for institutional clients, including verification and account activation.
  • Monitor client activity and trading patterns to identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
  • Develop strategic initiatives to expand institutional client relationships and drive trading activity.

Product & Relationship Management

  • Serve as the dedicated relationship lead for assigned institutional accounts, resolving day-to-day inquiries and operational issues within defined SLAs.
  • Proactively educate clients on new product launches, platform features, and market developments to support optimal platform usage.
  • Analyze client feedback and operational challenges, identifying meaningful signals that can drive product improvements and commercial outcomes.
  • Develop deep expertise in OKX’s product suite, trading infrastructure, and risk framework to provide informed guidance to institutional clients.
  • Manage dedicated client communication channels (Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, WeChat) and coordinate with internal teams including Product, API, Legal, and Compliance to deliver solutions and improvements.
  • Advocate internally for initiatives that enhance client experience, increase trading activity, and support long-term client retention.

Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure all client engagements strictly adhere to company policies, Terms of Service, and local regulatory requirements.
  • Support due diligence processes including DDQs, partnership agreements, and audit requests in collaboration with Legal and Compliance teams.
  • Maintain high standards of documentation, operational transparency, and regulatory alignment.
 

What We Look For In You

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in institutional sales, relationship management, or business development within crypto, fintech, or financial markets.
  • Strong understanding of digital asset trading products, institutional client workflows, and exchange infrastructure.
  • Proven experience managing institutional or high-value client relationships.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify commercial opportunities from client insights.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with product, engineering, compliance, and legal teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience working with institutional crypto clients such as funds, market makers, trading firms, or fintech platforms.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with APIs, trading infrastructure, and liquidity solutions.
  • Background in regulated financial markets or digital asset platforms.
  • Strong understanding of the global crypto ecosystem and institutional market dynamics.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance of company laptops, with macOS as the primary focus, as well as Windows computers, mobile devices (iOS and Android), IP phones, and other desktop IT equipment. This includes device imaging and setup, software and hardware installation, configuration, updates, maintenance, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.

  • Maintain office IT systems, including IP phones, video conferencing and wireless presentation systems, printers, CCTV, and access control. Support server room operations, structured cabling, UPS systems, switches, access points, and routine inspections. Monitor infrastructure availability and performance through dashboards and alerts. Basic knowledge of servers, networking, audio-visual systems, and electrical principles is required.

  • Perform daily monitoring and testing of office Wi-Fi, wired networks, and VPN connections, and troubleshoot network-related issues
  • Work with teams to identify valuable AI and automation opportunities, deliver end-to-end solutions, and drive adoption through demonstrations, training, and hands-on support. Measure the impact and use AI tools to improve troubleshooting, ticket handling, documentation, and reporting.
  • Support regional offices with IT rollouts, new office setups, and on-site project delivery. Travel when required and provide technical support and coordination throughout the implementation.
  • Create and maintain IT knowledge-sharing documents, SOPs, and the service desk knowledge base. Implement Global IT strategies, technical standards, guidelines, and solutions while continuously improving employees’ IT service experience and satisfaction.
  • Manage vendor relationships and coordinate equipment procurement, installation, maintenance, and technical support with external service providers.
 

What We Look For In You

  • Bachelor's degree or above; computer science, software engineering, networking or other related majors are preferred.

  • At least 3 years of working experience in IT support, IT engineering or a similar hands-on technical role, with working experience in large IT companies preferred. Operation and maintenance experience across Windows, macOS, WiFi network, VPN network and smart office systems is required.

  • Basic knowledge of server and network administration: Windows Server or Linux, virtualisation, backup and restore, switches, VLANs, WiFi controllers, firewalls and VPN. Certifications such as CCNA, Microsoft or Linux are a plus.

  • Demonstrated software engineering ability: strong Python (or an equivalent language) plus PowerShell or Bash; comfortable with Git and code review; able to build, test, document and maintain internal tools and integrations against REST APIs. Please be ready to share a portfolio, GitHub profile or examples of tools you have built.

  • Hands-on AI practitioner: daily user of AI assistants (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) with effective prompting skills, plus practical experience building AI agents, AI skills or MCP integrations. Experience deploying AI solutions for non-technical users is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable working directly with business stakeholders to turn unclear requirements into practical, deliverable solutions, and capable of presenting and providing training to non-technical users. Strong communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, with a proactive approach to problem-solving. Able to work independently and collaboratively, accommodate flexible working hours including evenings & weekends, and travel to regional offices when required.

  • Fluent in Malay,English and Mandarin listening and speaking

 
 

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive remuneration package (Basic Salary + Shift Allowance + KPI Allowance + Yearly Bonus)
  • Meal allowance
  • Transportation allowance (T&C apply)
  • Monthly team building
  • Fitness & wellness benefits per annum
  • Convenient workplace (5 minutes walk from MRT TRX)
  • Insurance coverage for employees & dependants
  • Excellent prospects for growth and promotion
  • Employee engagement, recognition and appreciation program
  • Multinational working environment: Advance your career by interacting with individuals from various backgrounds, cultures, and nations

  • Monitor and analyze key customer service metrics, identify issues and root causes through data, and develop and drive improvement plans.
  • Independently conduct data analysis, prepare business reports, and perform regular reviews to support team decision-making.
  • Proactively leverage AI to improve work efficiency, including data analysis, report generation, information processing, and building simple tasks or workflows.
  • Continuously optimize customer service processes, SOPs, knowledge bases, and productivity tools.
  • Collaborate with Product, Operations, Technology, and other teams to solve business problems and ensure high-quality, on-time project delivery.

岗位职责:

  • 负责客服团队日常运营管理，持续提升服务质量、用户体验及团队效率
  • 关注并分析客服核心数据，通过数据发现问题、定位原因，并制定和推动改善方案

title: Managing Director, Global Banking Partnerships
description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About The Opportunity

OKX runs one of the largest crypto exchange businesses in the world.
Our institutional banking relationships are central to the next phase of growth.
We are hiring a senior banker in Singapore to own the global bank relationship book under a single point of accountability, reporting to the Global Head of Strategic Partnerships.
This person is the institutional face of OKX to global banks, and the institutional face of global banks inside OKX.

What You’ll Be Doing 

  • Own the global bank relationship book as a portfolio.
    • Execute relationship strategy account by account across G-SIBs, and regional banks for the full operating and custody bank stack across all OKX regions.
    • Sequence partnership asks, manage escalations, source new partners, and own the executive ladder at each institution.
  • Serve as HQ's senior banking voice.
    • When the founder, Singapore C-Suite, or Global Head of Strategic Partnerships and his Financial Institutions Business Development Team needs a read on a counterparty — credit posture, risk appetite, partnership readiness, blockers, operationalization status and timeline — you are the call.
    • Host visiting bank executives, and you draft the narrative when OKX briefs local executives, the board, risk, payment product, or internal audit on the banking book.
  • Build the cultural bridge between bank and exchange.
    • The hardest part of being a G-SIB's chosen crypto counterparty is building and balancing the trust and business relationships between your internal and external stakeholders.
    • Translate structural and cultural differences in risk appetite, escalation culture, compliance, control, product, and operational reliance — Actively unblock issues before they become incidents.
  • Drive strategic banking workstreams.
    • Coordinate strategic banking and commercial partnerships with banks, working alongside the product and regional teams responsible for each initiative.

What We Look For In You 

  • 15–20 years inside a tier-1 global bank, with deep experience across two or more of the following:
    • Transaction and Commercial Banking / Cash Management / Correspondent Banking — The operating-account world: USD clearing, FX, wires, intraday liquidity, global T+0 rebalancing.
    • Coverage / Financial Institutions Group / Senior Relationship Management — Sector strategy, account planning, executive escalation. The senior-banker register.
    • Prime Brokerage / Securities Services / Triparty Custody — Financing, securities lending, security interest, triparty mechanics.
    • Digital Assets / Institutional Crypto Banking — A tier-1 bank's institutional digital-asset desk or equivalent. Already speaks both languages.
  • Operational and strategic understanding of:
    • How to establish long-term trust with G-SIBs as a crypto exchange counterparty;
    • Bank KYC and onboarding committee decision-making;

title: OEML - Senior Compliance Analyst
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe crypto will help reshape the future and contribute to greater individual freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions of customers access to crypto trading and decentralised applications. OKX is also trusted by institutions seeking secure access to crypto markets and is supported by its Proof of Reserves programme.
Across our global offices, we are united by three core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These values shape how we work and help us create a collaborative, rewarding and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Team

The Compliance function is responsible for promoting a strong compliance culture and supporting the safe, sustainable growth of OKX. We are a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on regulatory obligations, conduct expectations and enterprise risks.
OKX Europe Markets Limited operates within a significant EU regulatory perimeter as a MiFID II investment firm authorised under the Investment Services Act (Cap. 370), providing dealing on own account and execution of orders on behalf of clients on a matched-principal basis, together with trustee, custodian and nominee services, across the EEA on a cross-border services passport. Our product range includes crypto-asset perpetuals and expiry futures, single stock and ETF-linked futures, commodity futures and crypto-asset options, and is expanding into money market fund and structured product offerings.

About the Opportunity

As the Senior Compliance Analyst for OKX Europe Markets Limited, you will deliver the day-to-day operational compliance work of a fast-growing MiFID II investment firm: financial promotions review, complaints administration, regulatory and trade reporting support, monitoring testing and the firm's regulatory registers.
This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. The function reviews in the order of seventeen pieces of marketing and promotional material each week and handles around five new complaints each week, both scaling with a client base that is growing towards 100,000 users, alongside recurring regulatory reporting, token-listing and licence-extension assessments and compliance monitoring testing. You will be the person who keeps that machinery running accurately and on time.
You will gain broad exposure to MFSA supervision and EU financial services regulation, and direct visibility of how a MiFID II derivatives business is controlled in practice.
The position reports to the Deputy Head of Compliance, with a secondary reporting line to the Head of Compliance and MLRO, OKX Europe Markets Limited.

What You'll Be Doing

You will:
  • Review client-facing marketing material and financial promotions for compliance with MiFID II fair, clear and not misleading standards and the MFSA advertisement rules, across paid and organic social, email, landing pages, banners, push notifications, video and KOL briefs, and prepare them for approval by the Deputy Head of Compliance or the Head of Compliance.
  • Maintain the advertisement and marketing approval register, tracking each item from submission through amendment to approval, and supporting notifications to the MFSA where required.
  • Administer the end-to-end complaints process: logging and triage, investigation, preparation of customer responses within regulatory deadlines, remediation follow-up and escalation of significant or recurring issues to the Deputy Head of Compliance.
  • Produce complaints management information, root-cause and trend analysis to support the function's reporting to senior management, the Risk, Compliance and Audit Committee and the Board.
  • Support trade and transaction reporting obligations, including data collection and validation, regulatory return preparation, review and sign-off coordination, submission and evidence retention.
  • Conduct scheduled and ad-hoc testing under the Compliance Monitoring Programme, document findings, track remediation actions to closure and maintain the monitoring calendar.
  • Prepare token-listing and licence-extension assessments and supporting documentation for review, and support new product and feature compliance reviews and local launch sign-off.
  • Maintain the firm's core regulatory registers — regulatory correspondence, breaches, advertisements and the regulatory obligation register — ensuring an accurate, audit-ready flow of information to the MFSA and internal stakeholders.
  • Draft and update compliance policies, procedures and entity-specific addenda for review and approval, in line with regulatory developments.
  • Support regulatory-change horizon scanning, recording applicable changes against the obligation register and flagging implementation requirements.
  • Handle first-line queries on compliance and AML/CFT matters, escalating appropriately, and support responses to legal, regulatory and law-enforcement requests.
  • Support the retained AML/CFT work of the entity, including quality assurance sampling, high-risk onboarding and client-classification approvals, and internal and external audit support.
  • Support the preparation of compliance reports and Board and committee materials, and other materials required by internal stakeholders.
  • Work closely with teams such as Data, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Product and Risk to embed an effective compliance framework aligned with MFSA and EU standards.

What We Look For in You

  • Prior experience in a compliance, legal, regulatory or regulatory-operations role within financial services, investment firms, fintech or the crypto-asset sector.
  • Sound understanding of the MFSA regulatory framework, MiFID II conduct-of-business requirements and EU financial services regulation.
  • Demonstrable ability to handle a high, recurring caseload to deadline without loss of quality, and to prioritise between competing regulatory deadlines.
  • High attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accurate, complete and audit-ready records and registers.
  • Strong analytical ability, with the capacity to assess regulatory obligations against material or a process, identify gaps and produce well-reasoned written analysis.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to convey compliance requirements to non-specialist colleagues and to draft customer-facing responses.
  • Strong organisational skills, able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and meet regulatory deadlines.
  • Comfortable operating with limited supervision, exercising judgement within a defined framework and escalating appropriately.
  • A bachelor's degree in law, finance, business administration or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Professional fluency in English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience reviewing or approving financial promotions or marketing material in a regulated firm.
  • Experience administering a regulated complaints process.
  • Experience with trade or transaction reporting, or with compliance monitoring and control testing.
  • Experience working in Malta or with the Malta Financial Services Authority.
  • Familiarity with derivatives conduct topics such as leverage and margin, appropriateness and suitability, client categorisation and best execution.
  • A relevant professional qualification from the International Compliance Association, ACAMS or an equivalent body, or progress towards one.
  • Knowledge of and genuine enthusiasm for the crypto and digital-assets industry.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package.
  • Learning and development programmes and an education subsidy.
  • Team-building programmes and company events.
  • Wellness and meal allowances.
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants.
  • Additional benefits that we would be pleased to discuss during the recruitment process.

It's a large, high-complexity mobile surface built on a shared Rust/UniFFI core, and we're actively moving performance-critical paths to Rust so the logic is shared across platforms. A big, fast-moving codebase demands high standards for architecture, stability, and performance, so we invest consistently in review rigor, knowledge-sharing, and technical training to keep raising the bar. We're also a growth team, working closely with Product and Design to ship new strategies, improve the automated trading experience, and most recently build AI-driven bot experiences. What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the technical architecture and delivery of the Android/iOS Trading Bot codebase as your primary focus, while also contributing to Copy Trading as our second core surface, raising code quality, stability, and performance across both and across the flows that create, manage, copy, and follow strategies.
  • Lead large-scale technical initiatives end to end, from the Kotlin/Swift-to-Rust/UniFFI migration to modularization and binary-compatibility discipline across the Trading Bot and shared-core repositories, and the work to cut crash, ANR, and startup hotspots.
  • Join product requirement discussions, shape well-reasoned technical solutions, and protect product performance, stability, and user experience.
  • Partner with product and business to drive the Trading Bot roadmap, from new strategy types to sharing, attribution, and growth features, to AI-powered bot experiences, turning technical leverage into business impact.
  • Stay close to industry trends, keep refining the technical architecture, and grow the team's engineering capabilities through training and knowledge-sharing.
  • Mentor engineers and lead by influence, lifting the whole team's technical proficiency.
  • Lead the team in exploring the integration of AI into business scenarios, driving product and technology innovation.

What We Look For In You

  • Staff/Principal level Android/iOS expertise. 8+ years building and shipping production Android/iOS apps, with deep Kotlin and a strong command of multi-module architecture, dependency and binary-compatibility constraints, and platform performance (ANR, crash, startup, memory).
  • A track record of leading mid to large projects end to end. You hold a high bar for architecture and engineering quality, and you've raised that bar on a large, legacy-heavy codebase with results to show for it.
  • Technical strategy paired with business sense. You can set technical direction and work with product to turn it into roadmap and revenue. You own outcomes, not just code.
  • A trading or fintech background. Client-side experience at a crypto exchange, brokerage, or fintech app, with familiarity in core domains like order placement, market data, and asset management. Automated or algorithmic trading is a strong plus.
  • Influence and mentorship. You make the engineers around you better through review, design guidance, and knowledge-sharing, and you build alignment across teams without leaning on authority.

Nice-To-Haves

  • Cross-language or Rust experience. Rust, UniFFI/FFI, or iOS Swift/Obj-C, and comfort owning a shared cross-platform core.
  • Automated-trading domain depth. Hands-on with trading bots, grid or DCA strategies, perpetuals and derivatives, copy or social trading, or market-making and arbitrage, or trading in general.
  • AI engineering experience. LLM fundamentals, prompt engineering, RAG, or agent workflows, and an eye for bringing AI into both the product and the engineering workflow.
  • Performance and reliability tooling. APM, tracing, and crash or ANR triage at scale.
  • Scaled CI/CD. Experience with large monorepo or multi-module release systems, such as MMR-style merge pipelines.
  • Client-side team leadership. You've mentored or led a client-side team and can drive cross-team collaboration and technical review.

locationsText: Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR; Singapore, Singapore

description:

About The Opportunity

The Compliance team's primary objective is to ensure that OKX operates in accordance with regulatory requirements while maintaining the highest ethical and moral standards. The team owns the full compliance engineering stack: KYC onboarding and refresh, sanctions / PEP / adverse-media screening, transaction monitoring (TM) and travel-rule enforcement, case management, and regulatory reporting. We achieve this by developing compliance service solutions, integrating with KYC & AML vendors, and enabling robust business growth, which ultimately strengthens user trust in our platform. Our ultimate goal is to create a culture of compliance excellence, where innovation and responsible business practices are seamlessly integrated. In compliance, a system that is mostly right is wrong — so every control we build must be deterministic in its enforcement, complete in its coverage, and explainable in its outcome.



What You’ll Be Doing 

  • Formulate, select, and develop technical schemes for platform projects across the compliance domain — KYC onboarding flows, identity verification and refresh, sanctions / PEP / adverse-media screening, transaction monitoring, travel-rule, case management, and regulatory reporting — including AI/ML-powered features such as intelligent screening disambiguation, document verification, anomaly detection, automated risk scoring, and analyst-assist agents.
  • Organize and coordinate resources, leading project research and development, troubleshoot problems, and ensure quality and timely completion — including delivery of AI model integration work within KYC, screening, and monitoring workflows.
  • Facilitate cross-team communication and promote teamwork efficiency through code quality control and collaboration, including partnering with Data Science, Risk, and Legal to productionize models and ensure reliable, auditable inference infrastructure.
  • Define where probabilistic AI is appropriate versus where deterministic logic is mandatory — and design the boundary cleanly so models assist without compromising auditability or enforcement integrity.
  • Undertake team tasks and cultivate technical talents in the industry, with a focus on building AI engineering best practices across the compliance engineering team — patterns for agentic coding, prompt libraries, eval suites, and human-in-the-loop review of AI-generated work in a regulated environment.

 

What We Look For In You 

  • A compliance-first systems mindset — you instinctively reach for state machines, idempotency keys, exactly-once semantics, reconciliation jobs and immutable audit logs. You understand that in compliance, false negatives cost millions and false positives cost trust, and you design accordingly. Prior experience in KYC, AML, sanctions, fraud, or payments is a strong plus; experience surviving a regulatory audit is an even stronger plus.
  • Daily, fluent use of modern AI coding tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, or equivalents. You can describe the specific workflows you run, the failure modes you have hit, and the guardrails you have built around AI-generated code. AI fluency is required, not nice-to-have.
  • Production experience integrating AI/ML model inference into Java services — REST/gRPC-based model serving, feature engineering pipelines, latency-sensitive inference optimization, graceful degradation, and drift / rollback playbooks.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM application patterns — at least one of: RAG pipelines (vector store + retrieval + grounding) for policy / KYC / case lookup, agentic workflows (tool use, multi-step reasoning, validation loops) for analyst assistance, or LLM-based classification / extraction shipped to production.
  • Discipline around AI output — you do not ship LLM features without evals, hallucination tests, prompt regression suites, and human-in-the-loop review for high-stakes decisions. You have an opinion on when to reach for a frontier model vs. a fine-tuned small model vs. a deterministic rule, and can defend that trade-off to a regulator.
  • Exposure to LLM integration or AI agent frameworks is a strong plus — e.g. prompt engineering at the system level, RAG pipelines, or orchestrating AI workflows within a regulated environment.
  • Good understanding of software engineering basics, distributed system principles, including CAP, consistency, idempotency, and exactly-once vs at-least-once semantics.
  • Clear logic, quick thinking, and good communication skills — including the ability to write clearly for non-engineers (compliance officers, auditors, regulators).

 

AI Proficiency Expectations & Interview Process

AI fluency is a required engineering competency for this role, on the same level as ‘can write good Java’. We will assess it explicitly during the interview, and a strong showing here is a meaningful plus:
  • AI-augmented workflow demo — walk us through how you use AI tools day-to-day. The prompts, the tasks you delegate to an agent vs. write yourself, how you review AI-generated diffs, and how you measure the impact (commit velocity, defect rate, test coverage). Concrete examples beat slogans.
  • Live agentic exercise — a working session using the AI coding agent of your choice on a realistic compliance-flavoured problem. We look at how you scope, prompt, validate, and integrate AI output, not whether the agent gets it right first try.
  • Design discussion with a probabilistic twist — expect at least one system-design question where the right answer involves deciding when not to use an LLM, and how to design the deterministic fallback. We hire engineers who can defend that boundary.
  • Evaluation & guardrails — be ready to discuss an eval suite or guardrail you have built for an AI feature in production (e.g. an LLM-assisted SAR narrative drafting tool, an AI-assisted KYC document review step, or screening-hit disambiguation). If you have not shipped one, tell us how you would design it.

 

 

Perks & Benefits 

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development — including budget for AI tools, courses, and conferences
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

locationsText: Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR; Singapore, Singapore

description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX is going all-in on AI-native localisation. The field has long been stuck on one trade-off: you can have translation quality, or you can have scale, but not both. And the real question was never "is this translation accurate?" — it's "can the user actually understand it and get through the flow?"
Web3 is the hardest place to solve this. The vocabulary reinvents itself constantly, with new tech jargon, protocol names and memes appearing every week. It sits next to dense, high-stakes trading terminology, where a single mistranslated word can mislead a user or move money. And every market has its own fast-moving regulations, so the "right" translation is a moving target that must stay compliant across jurisdictions in real time. If you want a localisation problem that is genuinely unsolved — high ambiguity, high stakes, high velocity — this is it.
We're going to break the trade-off with agents. You will own the 0-1 build and launch of two things:
  • A frontier agentic translation system that localises every market (20+ languages) with a human-in-the-loop mechanism.
  • A self-improving agentic QA product that autonomously evaluates translation and end-to-end localisation quality, flags its own failures, and closes the loop.
This is a build-the-frontier role, not a manage-the-vendor role.
 
This role does not require a linguistics or translation background, multilingual ability, or algorithm engineering skills. We're looking for a PM leader who can build a frontier agentic translation and QA system from 0 to 1 — and make the whole organisation share responsibility for localisation quality.

What You’ll Be Doing

You will lead a squad of product managers and developers, and work hand-in-hand with language managers, to ship the translation and QA systems into production. You set the product direction and quality bar; your PMs and engineers build the agents, harness and evals; and the language managers ground the system in what "good" actually means in each market. Your job is to make these three groups operate as one team — and to make localisation quality something the whole organisation owns, not just the language team.
 

Own the agentic translation system

Architect and ship it end to end, from 0 to 1, across all markets and 20+ languages — where models carry the work and humans set the standard and make the final call. Break the cost curve: hold quality flat while coverage scales across languages, content and release velocity, so cost stops growing linearly with the business. Make the system interoperate cleanly with OKX's existing localisation stack and content pipelines, rather than living as an island.

Build the agentic QA and quality automation

Stand up an autonomous QA agent that evaluates translation and localisation quality at scale — catching regressions before release, monitoring in production, and self-verifying every fix, using LLM-as-a-judge and eval harnesses rather than manual review. Evaluate not just accuracy and fluency but cultural fit, bias and safety — especially on regulated and financial content, where a wrong or non-compliant phrasing is a real risk. Make quality measurable: define and drive a hard quality signal — human-acceptance rate, or the edit effort needed to reach shippable quality (e.g. Translation Time-to-Edit) — so quality is a metric the system optimises against, not a subjective call. And protect the funnel: conversion on key user journeys should never be adversely affected by language or localisation issues.

Make it self-improving

Drive a sustained reduction in severe and recurring production issues — every escape becomes a new guardrail, and the system gets smarter with every release.
 

What We Look For In You 

  • PM leader who has taken a frontier agentic product from 0 to 1, beyond translation.
  • Proven ability to ship genuinely novel products at the edge of LLM capabilities—and repeat that success here.
  • Accountable for business outcomes and measured on business metrics, not delivery volume.
  • Deep hands-on experience building large-scale, frontier-LLM agentic systems from 0 to 1.
  • Experience with harness/orchestration layers, multi-agent workflows, and LLM-as-a-judge or automated evaluation pipelines.
  • Has built quality systems, automated evaluations, or release gates that enable confident autonomous-system launches.
  • International product experience serving users across multiple languages and regions.

Nice to Haves

  • Built an agentic system from scratch
  • Shipped agentic / LLM applications in production
  • Finance, payments or another highly regulated industry.

  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events

We are looking for an experienced blockchain developer to join our team building the next generation of high-performance on-chain trading infrastructure. You will help design and implement a unified trading engine — supporting Perpetuals, Spot, and Prediction Markets under a single margin account — and contribute to ExchangeOS, an infrastructure layer that lets KYC'd institutions and Web3 entities stake to create and operate their own trading venues (DEXs) on top of our chain.
 

What You’ll Be Doing

  1. Design and build a unified account and matching system that supports Perpetuals, Spot, and Prediction Markets — including on-chain order matching, cross-margin validation, settlement, and liquidation/risk engines (ADL, ADL-avoidance, ADL waterfall, ecosystem insurance fund mechanics).

  3. Drive performance engineering across the stack — parallel transaction execution, low-latency order pipelines, and throughput/latency optimization at the engine and chain level.
  4. Track cutting-edge blockchain and trading-system technology (e.g. Hyperliquid, dYdX, other high-performance perp DEX architectures) and apply best practices to our infrastructure.
  5. Partner with product and business teams to translate venue/exchange requirements into technical designs, and provide ongoing technical support.
 

What We Look For In You

  1. Strong proficiency in Rust, with hands-on experience in high-performance, low-latency systems; experience with parallel/concurrent execution engines is a strong plus.
  2. Deep understanding of exchange/matching engine mechanics: order book design, margin systems, liquidation and ADL, settlement, and risk engines — familiarity with perpetual, spot, or prediction market products is a strong plus.
  3. Solid grounding in blockchain fundamentals (consensus, P2P networking, cryptography); experience reading core code of major L1/L2 systems (Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, or high-performance L1s like Hyperliquid/Solana) is a plus but not the primary focus of this role.
  4. Strong systems-performance mindset: profiling, memory/allocator tuning, and designing for sub-millisecond latency at scale.
  5. Excellent teamwork, communication, and logical reasoning skills; genuine passion for trading systems and blockchain technology.
